stemMarkdown: A bag contains 4 red balls and 5 blue balls. Two balls are drawn at random without replacement. What is the probability that both are red? (Round to 6 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Choose 2 from the 4 red balls out of 2 from all 9: $\dfrac{\binom{4}{2}}{\binom{9}{2}} = \dfrac{6}{36} = 0.166667$.
